verdict.rationale: Bun documents automatic lockfile migration from yarn.lock, package-lock.json, and pnpm-lock.yaml on first `bun install`, plus drop-in compatibility with npm's package.json fields (overrides, workspaces) enabling switchers to reuse existing projects without rewriting configs. Community comments confirm real-world usage as a package-manager swap-in, though some report install bugs tied to leftover lockfiles/node_modules during migration. Missing for 10: a dedicated migration guide beyond lockfile conversion, and stronger independent verification that conversion is reliably bug-free across ecosystems.
